title: lichen/tests/coap_config/src/main.c:373 hardcodes rejected IID-embedding primary address
description: Found during 0qcc review (lci_identity.json migration). lichen/tests/coap_config/src/main.c:373 does strcpy(test_identity.primary, "2ed:4242:ead4:ac69:ed42:42ea:d4ac:6948") for pubkey 03a107bff3ce10be1d70dd18e74bc09967e4d6309ba50d5f1ddc8664125531b8 (seed 000102..1f). That is the REJECTED IID-embedding native profile (settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision); the C test never reads test/vectors/lci_identity.json so it self-confirms a non-conformant address. Correct upstream AddrForKey value: 206:2f7c:2006:18f7:a0f1:4791:738c:5a1f (packed 02062f7c200618f7a0f14791738c5a1f), derived by an independent reimplementation anchored byte-for-byte to the genuine upstream Go vector in test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json. Note: coap_config app currently has a build blocker (0whw, zcbor headers) — this fixture fix is content-only and independent of that.
